completed.title: Related Posts Widget
completed.description: Add Related Posts widget with intelligent tag-based matching algorithm
completed.solution: Created intelligent RelatedPosts component with multi-factor scoring algorithm: same category (+3 points), shared tags (+2 each), featured bonus (+1). Implemented fallback to recent posts when no matches found. Shows 3 related posts with thumbnail, title, date, reading time, and excerpt. Responsive grid (1/2/3 columns). Integrated server-side post fetching in page.tsx and replaced basic implementation in BlogPostClient. Fully memoized for performance.
features: Tag-based similarity matching (2 points per shared tag)
Fallback to recent posts when score = 0
Rich card UI with image, title, date, reading time
Responsive grid (1 col mobile, 2 tablet, 3 desktop)

algorithm.fallback: Recent posts when no relevant matches

completed.title: Loading States & Skeleton Screens
completed.description: Add skeleton loading states for better perceived performance across the site
completed.solution: Created comprehensive skeleton loading UI system with reusable components (Skeleton, SkeletonText, SkeletonImage, SkeletonCard, SkeletonList, SkeletonBlogPost, SkeletonProject). Integrated route-level loading states via Next.js loading.tsx files for blog and project pages. Added shimmer animation keyframe to globals.css. Skeleton layouts closely match real content structure with smooth fade-in transitions when content loads.
features: Content-specific skeletons for blog posts and projects

completed.title: Code Syntax Highlighting
completed.description: Add beautiful code syntax highlighting for blog posts using Shiki
completed.solution: Implemented Shiki-powered code highlighting with dual theme support, copy button, language badges, and 25+ supported languages. Migrated from react-syntax-highlighter for better performance (pre-rendered HTML). Features include theme-aware rendering, hover interactions, and zero runtime cost. All 47 tests passing.
benefits: Better performance (pre-rendered HTML vs client-side JS)

completed.title: Table of Contents
completed.description: Implement auto-generated table of contents with hierarchical structure for blog posts
completed.solution: Enhanced existing TOC to support both H2 and H3 headings with hierarchical structure. Implemented automatic heading extraction from markdown, active section tracking on scroll, smooth scrolling navigation, and visual hierarchy with indentation. Sticky sidebar ensures TOC stays visible. Active section highlighted with accent color and left border indicator.
features: H2 and H3 heading extraction with level detection
Active section tracking using intersection detection
IDs generated for both H2 and H3 for linking
